prelaunch_updates.text: OPEN CAMPAIGN: AMA recap by a community account says the Quest and Mindshare points campaigns end Fri 10/30 and this week's points are paid Monday; each campaign has its own QUIP allocation. Not yet posted by @quipnetwork, so unconfirmed. Mainnet and TGE come after the external audit, still undated. Any QUIP token now is a scam.

OPEN CAMPAIGN: GEN airdrop registration closes this Saturday, Oct 31 (time not given). Only official link: airdrop.genlayer.com. TGE still undated; any GEN token before an official token address is a scam.
Flop Labs: Devnet join instructions by early next week. Arthur Hayes says the public Devnet opens within days and does not count toward any airdrop. No FLOP token exists; any FLOP is a scam.

Final stretch to mainnet: accounts, swaps, points, compute subnets and QVM are live on testnet; one step left, an external chain audit. Discord AMA Thu 10/29 morning US time. OPEN CAMPAIGN repeat: Quip Points open, no end date. No QUIP token or TGE date yet.

Dataline names its token DAT. The DAT auction runs on Uniswap as a CCA (set a budget and a max price; it runs for several days). Start date, FDV and vesting not posted yet. Any DAT token before an official token address is a scam.
Scam alert: people impersonating the TermiX team are asking for investments. TermiX says it runs no community fundraising of any kind. No TMT token or sale exists yet.

GenLayer explains GEN staking: validators must lock GEN to sit on a case, juries grow on appeal, and cheaters lose part of their stake. TGE still undated. OPEN CAMPAIGN: airdrop registration (reopened Tue 10/27) still has no closing date; only link airdrop.genlayer.com.
OPEN CAMPAIGN repeat: Quip Points still open at points.quip.network (no end date). Telegram and YouTube quests (25 points each) are left. No QUIP token or TGE date yet; any QUIP token is a scam.

GenLayer says scammers are already active before TGE and ChainPatrol is now watching for fake accounts and lookalike domains. TGE still undated; any GEN token before an official token address is a scam.

OPEN CAMPAIGN: GEN airdrop registration has reopened 'for a few more days' at airdrop.genlayer.com (the only official link). No new closing date or time given. Any token claiming GEN before an official token address is a scam.

report.intro: Quiet night for launches: no new priority (0 of 3). GenLayer set its airdrop registration close for Sat 10/31, Quip says only an external audit stands before mainnet, QTC lending went live on RHEA, and Verona added NIST post-quantum signatures to its mainnet. The 12, 4 and 8 PM scans on Wed 10/28 did not run (usage limit), so this report covers the full 25 hours.

report.disclaimer: Research, not financial advice. Snapshots only; verify every token address yourself.
takeaways: No new alerts (0 of 3). The Wed 10/28 afternoon and evening scans were missed while usage was out; this sweep covers that gap.
OPEN: GenLayer airdrop registration closes Sat 10/31, time not given (official). airdrop.genlayer.com only. You chose to skip GenLayer on 10/25, so it stays off the desk box.
OPEN: Quip Points still open (points.quip.network), 1,086 points, Telegram and YouTube quests left. Quip Discord AMA on QVM today, morning US time.
Quantus (81): QTC lending is live on RHEA on NEAR (RHEA official). Native lending on the Quantus chain is next, undated.
Verona (formerly XION) shipped Fermi on mainnet: opt-in ML-DSA and SLH-DSA account keys. Added as WATCH 66; it is already trading, so it gets a milestone note, not an alert.
Dataline token is DAT, sold by Uniswap CCA auction; dates and terms still missing. Flop Devnet opens within days and earns no airdrop.
Rejected: ChyAI (anonymous agents-only launchpad), MindZap AI (farm hype) and Ozone Chain (unconfirmed quantum claims, thin volume).

notes.text: GenLayer (71) is the pre-launch project closest to the bar. It is still missing a dated TGE, an audit and an official token address.
Quip (65) needs its external audit and a dated TGE. DAC (48) needs @dac_chain to post its own date and token address.
Quantus (81) $78.74 (+4%), range $75.38 to $81.17; QTC lending live on RHEA. Verona (66) is new: PQ account keys are opt-in, so existing accounts are not protected until users switch.
Ritual (76) is already alerted and live. It still lacks a real DEX pool and an audit. Axis fell 34% once the OKX contest ended, confirming the volume was contest-driven.
Soqucoin trades on SafeTrade and NonKYC only (no DEX). TensorCash trades only on SafeTrade.

Tier comes from the Oracle Score (75+ Strong, 55 to 74 Watch, under 55 Speculative). It does not reflect market cap, and "No DEX" only means there is no official DEX route, not that a project is low quality.

Pearl (PRL) has no official DEX route. The Uniswap WPRL token comes from a third-party bridge and the Solana "PEARL" pools showing tens of millions are fakes. Its $644M market cap is circulating; fully diluted value is about $3.8B.
Tier comes from the Oracle Score, not market cap. QRL and Abelian have no DEX because QRL and ABEL tokens on Base or Solana are look-alike; Abelian also trades on only one exchange (MEXC).
